learning_outcomes.text: Students can formally describe algorithms and prove their correctness.
Students can analyze and evaluate the runtime and memory requirements of algorithms and data structures.
Students know fundamental schemata for algorithm design.
Students are able to develop algorithms and data structures for specific problems.
Students have learned the basics of the Python programming language.

syllabus_topics: Design and analysis of algorithms and data structures
Basic methods of algorithm analysis (correctness, runtime, memory requirements)
Fundamental data structures (lists, arrays, search trees, heaps)
Graphs: representation and algorithms (traversals, shortest paths, minimal spanning trees)
Theoretical analysis of algorithms and data structures
Practical implementation in a modern programming language (e.g., Python)
assessment_rules: Credits are awarded upon passing the written exam (150 minutes).
